unfold.unfolded:
Let $G$ be a connected reductive group, $T$ a maximal torus of $G$, $P$ a parabolic subgroup of $G$, $\lambda$ the weight of the paper, and let $t\in T$ be of finite order and $n\geqslant 0$ an integer. Write $G^t:=Z_G(t)$, $(G^t)^o$ for its identity component, and $Y_t$ for the set of connected components of $Z_G(t)$, indexed as $Y_t=\{v\in W^P:\ B^t\cdot vP/P=vP/P\}$. For $v\in Y_t$ let $X_P^t(v)$ be the connected component of the smooth variety $X_P^t$ indexed by $v$. Then
\[
\Theta_{n\lambda}(t^{-1})=\sum_{v\in Y_t} D_v^t(n,\lambda),
\]
where
\[
D_v^t(n,\lambda)=\sum_{k\geqslant 0}\int_{X_P^t(v)}\frac{c_1\bigl(\mathcal{L}(\lambda)|_{X_P^t(v)}\bigr)^k\,\frac{n^k}{k!}\,e^{-nv\lambda}(t)\cdot \mathrm{td}(X_P^t(v))}{\prod_{\alpha\in (vR_P^+)\setminus R((G^t)^o)}\bigl[1-e^\alpha(t)\,e^{-c_1(\overline{\mathcal{L}}(\alpha)|_{X_P^t(v)})}\bigr]},
\]
$R_P^+$ is the set of roots of the unipotent radical of $P$, $\mathrm{td}$ is the Todd genus of the tangent bundle, and $\overline{\mathcal{L}}(\alpha)$ is the line bundle attached to the root $\alpha$ as in the identification of the paper.

inlined.part: the set Y_t of connected components and the connected components X_P^t(v), with the parametrization by v in W^P

assumed: character of a finite order element
notes: The paper does not define X_P^t as a variety in the given context; it is taken as the smooth variety of Proposition 2.1 with S replaced by t, so G^S becomes G^t = Z_G(t) (the paper's Y_t is the component set of Z_G(t)).
The symbols Theta_{n lambda}, lambda, and the identification defining \overline{\mathcal{L}}(alpha) are not in the given context; they are left as written in the paper.
The paper uses vR_P^+ for the translate of the set of roots by v; this is read as {v(alpha): alpha in R_P^+}.
The paper uses \backslash for set difference; it is read as \setminus.

verdict.reason: The unfolded form preserves the hypotheses, identity, and definition of each summand. Its added descriptions spell out notation referenced in the original without changing the claim.
